title: Judge detection of synthetic bugs (T18 mutants)

steps.name: mutate
steps.cmd: nice python3 ext/E5/mutate.py runs/E3.j00.jsonl runs/E5.j00.jsonl runs/E5_work
steps.pilot_cmd: nice python3 ext/E5/mutate.py runs/E3p.j00.jsonl runs/E5p.j00.jsonl runs/E5p_work

steps.name: judge_tev
steps.cmd: python3 judge_label.py runs/E5.j00.jsonl ext/E3/config.json tev runs/E5.j01.jsonl --tiers local3b+off_by_one,local3b+flip_comparison,local3b+swap_args,local3b+wrong_init,local3b+drop_guard,local3b+early_exit
steps.pilot_cmd: python3 judge_label.py runs/E5p.j00.jsonl ext/E3/config.json tev runs/E5p.j01.jsonl --tiers local3b+off_by_one,local3b+flip_comparison,local3b+swap_args,local3b+wrong_init,local3b+drop_guard,local3b+early_exit --max-rep 2

steps.name: judge_llama
steps.cmd: python3 judge_label.py runs/E5.j01.jsonl ext/E3/config.json llama runs/E5.j02.jsonl --tiers local3b+off_by_one,local3b+flip_comparison,local3b+swap_args,local3b+wrong_init,local3b+drop_guard,local3b+early_exit
steps.pilot_cmd: python3 judge_label.py runs/E5p.j01.jsonl ext/E3/config.json llama runs/E5p.j02.jsonl --tiers local3b+off_by_one,local3b+flip_comparison,local3b+swap_args,local3b+wrong_init,local3b+drop_guard,local3b+early_exit --max-rep 2
